sprints.theme: Saturate 4×H200 — GPU-bound by killing I/O+CPU tax in the encode path
sprints.summary: Shipped 2026-05-27 (zarr-consolidate) + 2026-05-28 (frame-precompute). Both perf wins land; corpus encode hit 308 fps/GPU peak via the in-process stream_encode.py path that replaced the optimisation targets. Side-quest: bench harness moved to the same in-process pattern (commit c759282) — ~55× speedup; rFID gate measurement landed at 16.25 on the 100-shot in-process bench (job 1208918).

Closed 2026-05-29 with a NEGATIVE-but-decisive result that re-founded the project. The Open-MAGVIT2 decoder fine-tune (v0 0.1·LPIPS, Option B 1.0·LPIPS) was confirmed ~7pt WORSE than the untrained baseline on rFID — robust to rFID pool size (Option D, 8 & 32 frame) and to decoder precision (job 1209184 ruled out a bf16-measurement artifact). Conclusion: tuning a 2D decoder against rFID is a dead-end, and rFID is the wrong north-star for a dynamics model. world-model-v0 retains the baseline imagenet OMAG2 decoder where camera decoding is needed; the camera generative WM is demoted to a byproduct. The project pivots to a probabilistic state-space model (see physics-world-model-strategy); next sprint S7 stands up the Stage-1 engine. Bugs fixed en route: C5 resize, C8 frame-selection, rfid_frames_per_shot 8→32 default, merged-ckpt clobber, /tmp visibility, bench bf16-decode diagnostic toggles.

sprints.theme: Stage-3 — MSE-free multi-modal current-profile recovery (beat EnKF)

items.why_now: The ratified pivot. Stage-1 + Stage-2 closed with honest results; recover the internal current profile WITHOUT MSE from raw multi-modal data, beating a classical EnKF baseline — the ITER-startup problem (no MSE, must still recover the current profile).
items.done_when: An MSE-free end-to-end obs->state neural filter beats the EnKF baseline on the three-axis win (MSE-observable RMSE; coverage [0.88,0.92]; CRPS/NLL on transients), validated on held-out raw MSE. The EnKF baseline + held-out-MSE eval harness are built first.

sprints.description: Build an end-to-end observation->state deep neural filter on raw multi-modal diagnostics (magnetics + ane + bolometer + SXR + visible camera + Thomson) that recovers MSE-derived internal-current observables it never sees as input, beating a classical EnKF baseline. Front-load the EnKF baseline + held-out-MSE eval harness to learn the bar early. Scope locks: observables/on-axis only (full continuous q(psi) OUT); EFIT eval-only boundary/global sanity-check; architecture = end-to-end obs->state. Grounded in the 7-reader deep review (wpy0754zv, 2026-05-31).
sprints.summary: Closed 2026-06-02. Delivered the eval substrate + a strong characterization of the MSE-free problem, ending in a principled NO-GO that re-shaped the path. Built: D1 held-out-MSE eval harness + 112-shot cross-family/cross-shot split (statespace/mse_eval+mse_split); D3 multi-modal loaders (camera/chord/Thomson); D2 classical EnKF/TORAX bar — full N=112 pitch RMSE 0.225 [0.199,0.259], recovery confirmed PHYSICS-driven (forecast~=analysis; magnetics assimilation barely moves the interior); a findings doc with j(rho,t) evolution plots. KEY RESULT: a supervised oracle (3 arms on the locked metric) returned QUALIFIED_NEGATIVE — time-history adds nothing (0.190~=0.188), the near-axis interior is model-failure-floored ~0.41 rad for magnetics+ALL multimodal (re-confirms equilibrium under-determination), SXR/rational-surface not significant, bolo only a small off-interior carrier. The binding constraint is interior INFORMATION, not ML architecture or dynamics. NO-GO on the multimodal-neural-D4 v0 -> PIVOT to S10 (strong sequential full-state baseline + kinetic-pressure-via-GS-p' before ML). Infra: reckon dangling-link check + stamp-on-serve fix landed. mse-free-current-recovery-v0 stays the M3 north-star (win condition unchanged); S10 builds the foundation under it.
